g.aria-label: Cloud Trust Boundaries: Community Marketplaces vs. Vetted Clouds
Physical server operated by an unknown 3rd party
Host root can inspect container RAM & GPU VRAM
Disk encryption DOES NOT hide live RAM keys!
Risk: Leaked S3 keys, private weights/code
Safe only for public coursework & open data
Required for proprietary models & customer PII
Security Rule: Never place long-lived cloud root credentials on any rented GPU instance.
Use read-only or bucket-scoped tokens that expire automatically when the job finishes.
